Class SelectedTileController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.SelectedTileController
public class SelectedTileController extends Object
Controller for managing the selected component tile during the ship assembly phase. Handles component display, rotation, placement confirmation, removal, and reservation. Provides visual feedback and validation for component placement operations.
